newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal GDP growth quickened in Q2 1996 - INE.
newsitem.headline: Portugal GDP growth quickened in Q2 1996 - INE.

text.p: The Portuguese economy grew 2.5 percent in the year to June 1996 against growth of 2.1 percent in the 12 months to March, according to preliminary figures released by the National Statistics Institute (INE).
But the Institute said that final figures for June could show slightly lower growth because the preliminary numbers take no account of the variation in stock levels.
The government forecasts economic growth near 2.75 percent for the whole of 1996.
